'''2005 World Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed World Championship, held at Gen Con in Indianapolis, Indiana.<ref name="awards">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards and Hall of Fame], starwarsccg.org; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20230817222457/https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ 17 August 2023]</ref> [[Drew Scott]] defeated [[James Booker]].<ref name="awards" />

The constructed pool was printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] plus original [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Players Committee Virtual Sets]] then legal. A numbered original-VS cutoff for this event is not dested here.

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Dates:''' 2005
* '''Site:''' Gen Con, Indianapolis, Indiana
* '''Winner:''' [[Drew Scott]]
* '''Runner-up:''' [[James Booker]]

== Day 3 ==

A 2020 forum post quoting an earlier player compilation gives this top 8 bracket (seeds in brackets).<ref name="f75427-1300387">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1300387#p1300387 Post by Yoshi], "SWCCG Worlds Day 3 Standings History", forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html#p1300387 Internet Archive]</ref> Another post in the thread recalls Reid Smith, Brad Eier, James Booker, Drew Scott and Alden Peterson in the top 8.<ref name="f75427-1300366">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1300366#p1300366 Post by Aglets], "SWCCG Worlds Day 3 Standings History", forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html#p1300366 Internet Archive]</ref>

* Quarterfinals: (8) [[Drew Scott]] def. (1) [[Reid Smith]]; (7) [[Nate Meeker]] def. (2) [[Alden Peterson]]; (6) [[James Booker]] def. (3) Jared Lockwood; (4) [[Brad Eier]] def. (5) [[Brandon Schele]]
* Semifinals: Drew Scott def. Brad Eier; James Booker def. Nate Meeker
* Final: Drew Scott def. James Booker
